_meta.description: Quest dialogue for MQ-23: Alliance Forged. Year 2 Autumn — securing reinforcements from allied towns.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: The Council has responded to the Marshal's broadcast. Three Beacon Towns are willing to discuss sending reinforcements: Thornwall, Dusthaven, and Ironridge.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: But 'willing to discuss' isn't the same as 'committed.' Each town has conditions. Jack, I need you to visit them and close the deal.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: Diplomacy. Wonderful. Try not to start any wars on the way there.

lines.speaker: thornwall_leader
lines.text: Coppervale's engineer. We've heard a great deal about you. Thornwall will send a militia company — 30 fighters — but we need something in return.

lines.speaker: thornwall_leader
lines.text: Our northern wall is crumbling. Your turret designs would let us hold it with half the manpower. Share the blueprints, and our fighters are yours.

choices.text: Done. I'll have the blueprints sent by courier tomorrow.
I'll share defensive turret specs only — not the advanced models. Fair?

lines.speaker: thornwall_leader
lines.text: Generous. You'll have our best fighters. The Beacon alliance is stronger for this.

lines.speaker: thornwall_leader
lines.text: Hmm. Acceptable, though I'd hoped for more. We'll send 15 fighters instead of 30. Proportional to the trust offered.

lines.speaker: dusthaven_leader
lines.text: We're a farming settlement, not warriors. But we can send food, medical supplies, and 10 volunteers who know how to handle a crossbow.

lines.speaker: dusthaven_leader
lines.text: What we need is protection after the siege. If the Marshal retaliates against us for helping you... we can't survive that alone.

choices.text: You have my word. After we stop the Marshal, Coppervale will help defend Dusthaven. We'll station guard bots on your perimeter.
I can't make promises about what comes after. But your supplies would save lives during the siege.

lines.speaker: dusthaven_leader
lines.text: That's all we needed to hear. Our people and supplies will be in Coppervale before the first frost.

lines.speaker: dusthaven_leader
lines.text: Honest, at least. We'll send the supplies but our volunteers will stay home. We can't risk orphaning our children on a maybe.

lines.speaker: ironridge_leader
lines.text: Ironridge has miners, not soldiers. But we know tunnels, explosives, and structural engineering. Give us a role in your defense plan, and we'll send a sapper team.

lines.speaker: ironridge_leader
lines.text: Our condition: after the siege, we want access to the Mountain Bunker. The mineral deposits in that region would sustain Ironridge for decades.

choices.text: The bunker's been cleared. It's yours to mine. Coppervale only needed the technology inside.
Mining rights are a big ask. I'll grant access to the upper levels, but the research wing stays sealed.

lines.speaker: ironridge_leader
lines.text: Ha! Fair deal. You'll have our best sappers — they can set traps that'd make a Rust Wolf think twice about breathing.

lines.speaker: ironridge_leader
lines.text: Upper levels only? That's... something. We'll send a smaller team. Five sappers instead of twelve.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: Alliance status confirmed. I've tallied the commitments based on your negotiations.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: Whatever we've got, we work with it. I'll integrate the allied forces into our defense plan. The siege won't catch us unprepared.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Jack, the alliance strength directly affects our defensive capability. Every fighter, every supply crate, every sapper counts. You've done well.
